column1: # Evangelion 64 English script. Tab separated: string id, English text.
# Ids come from work\extract\text\strings_jp.tsv. \n is a line break. Lines starting with # are notes.
# Build with:  tools\eva64\build.bat scripts\strings_en.tsv eva64_en en
# Speakers are not shown in the game; they are noted here from the scene.

column2: UN forces launch a fierce assault.
But the object\ndoes not budge an inch.
Is conventional firepower\nno match for it...?
Yes, there's no mistake.\n It's an Angel...
Destroy the Angel\nright above NERV HQ.
Hold it off with the intercept\n system until Unit-01 launches!
Is that all right with you?
Of course. Unless we defeat the\n Angels, we have no future.
Ikari...\n are you sure about this?

column2: Across all of Kanto and Chubu,\ncentered on the Tokyo region,
Is this a new Angel attack...?
All personnel,\n Level One battle stations.
any threat within a set range.

Is there any way to defeat it?

column2: I see no reason to object.\n Go ahead, Captain Katsuragi.

I will now give your assignments\n for this operation.
Shinji,\n you'll be the gunner in Unit-01.
Rei, you'll handle defense\n in Unit-00.
Earth's spin, magnetic field and\n gravity bend a positron's path.
Don't forget to correct\n for that error.
So I...\n just need to protect Unit-01.
I'm entrusting all of Japan's\n energy to you.
Direct attack from\nextreme range with\nthe Positron Rifle.

\nan N2 mine and halted the Angel.

Destroy the Angel\nwith a simultaneous\ntwo-Eva strike.

confirms the shadow of\nsomething inside the crater.

appears in satellite orbit\nabove the Indian Ocean.

Destroy the Angel\nwith the Dummy Plug.

Unit-00, with the high-output\nModified Positron Rifle,

Destroy the Angel\nin orbit with the\nLance of Longinus.

Controlling Unit-02 is\nthe Fifth Child, Kaworu Nagisa.

column2: Silence Unit-02, which\nKaworu controls, and\ndestroy the Angel.
The JSSDF's all-out assault\non NERV has begun.
\n"So the last enemy was\n our fellow man after all..."
As expected, poison must\n be fought with poison.
Destroy every unit\nof the Eva Series.
